title: a recursive CTE walking down the org chart from one manager, an iteration at a time

steps.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE team AS (
  SELECT id, name, title, 0 AS depth
  FROM employees
  WHERE id = 14
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.id, e.name, e.title, t.depth + 1
  FROM employees AS e
  JOIN team AS t ON e.manager_id = t.id
)
SELECT id, name, title, depth FROM team ORDER BY depth, id
steps.note: Ama Rossi's team, walked one level per iteration.

stages.note: the anchor runs once: Ama Rossi, manager, employee 14. she is the whole working table, and the first row of the result.

steps.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE team AS (
  SELECT id, name, 0 AS depth
  FROM employees
  WHERE id = 14
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.id, e.name, t.depth + 1
  FROM employees AS e
  JOIN team AS t ON e.manager_id = t.id
) SEARCH BREADTH FIRST BY id SET ord
SELECT id, name, depth, ord FROM team ORDER BY ord
steps.note: SEARCH BREADTH FIRST: a level at a time, like the iterations ran. ord is (depth, id) under the hood.

WITH RECURSIVE team AS (

  FROM employees
  WHERE id = 14
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.id, e.name, t.depth + 1
  FROM employees AS e
  JOIN team AS t ON e.manager_id = t.id

SELECT id, name, depth, ord FROM team ORDER BY ord
steps.note: SEARCH DEPTH FIRST: down one branch to the bottom before the next. ord is the path of ids from the top, so sorting by it walks the tree.
